specialRules.Battle Built: When this vehicle is damaged by an attack a passenger may [RE]act as if they were damaged.

specialRules.Classic Profile: While this Vehicle has no RED Hull tokens, attacks against the Vehicle's driver targets the Vehicle instead.

specialRules.Off-Road Ready: This Vehicle's Driver gains Accurate on Steer rolls to move over Obstacles.

specialRules.Battle Built: When this vehicle is damaged by an attack a passenger may [RE]act as if they were damaged.

specialRules.Street Racer: After easy Steer actions, this Vehicle may move forward RED (but not rotate).

specialRules.Turbo Speeds: When this Vehicle's driver takes GREEN Steer action, they may make the Action RED and gain Rapid 2.

specialRules.Commutor: If this Vehicle's driver ends its activation without taking a Steer action, they may take a free RED Steer action

specialRules.Ambulance: Friendly medical actions targeting a model in seat 3 or 4 gain Accurate.

specialRules.Cycle Deployment: The Cycle Rack seat may only hold a Cycle model [without passnegers or side car mods]. When a model disembarks, it may disembark the Cycle as well and become its driver.

specialRules.Fast Ropes: Models may disembark at YELLOW hover height.
